item.description: Fix rapid-usage alerts that missed gradual quota drain. AgentsEye now tracks cumulative usage across refreshes within the last hour, so a drop from 100% to 83% remaining triggers the enabled 10-point alert. Readings from earlier quota cycles and readings older than an hour are excluded.

AgentsEye 0.17.21 stops repeated Claude Code Keychain prompts.
- Background refresh no longer reads Claude Code's Keychain item. - Background refresh no longer launches `claude auth status`, which could independently request Keychain access every five minutes. - Disconnecting Claude usage now prevents all Claude credential reads while keeping local Claude session history available. - Connected Claude usage can still use an existing on-device credentials file or a current claude.ai session in Zen or Firefox. - OpenCode Go continues to use the correct 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows. Its API currently reports whole-number percentages, while the OpenCode dashboard may show decimals.

## Cursor prompts are now visible
- Reads user-authored prompts from Cursor's first-party local agent transcripts after Prompt Intelligence is enabled. - Links Cursor prompt chains to the exact local Cursor composer session. - Keeps transcript-only Cursor conversations navigable when Cursor omits their composer header. - Shows Cursor as the calling harness and preserves the local workspace label. - Excludes assistant messages, subagent transcripts, and browser data. - Keeps the same local redaction, encryption, retention, and deletion controls used by other supported prompt sources.
